subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat replies convert OpenClaw markdown into Google Chat-supported formatting, strip unsupported markdown to plain text, or document raw markdown passthrough while only fixing typing identity?
rationale: The typing fallback is a narrow bug fix, but markdown handling affects user-visible formatting semantics and the closed markdown PR discussion challenged a strip-only approach.

options.title: Convert supported formatting
options.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that preserves supported emphasis/code/link behavior where possible, strips unsupported constructs, and keeps the typing identity fallback in the same plugin-local fix.

options.title: Strip to plain text
options.body: Treat Google Chat output as plain text and remove markdown markers consistently, accepting loss of formatting for simpler behavior.

options.title: Only fix typing identity
options.body: Land the identity-name fallback and explicitly document current markdown passthrough as intended, leaving formatting changes out of scope.

recommendation.title: Convert supported formatting
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that preserves supported emphasis/code/link behavior where possible, strips unsupported constructs, and keeps the typing identity fallback in the same plugin-local fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history in the reply-delivery path and is the best available routing candidate for the rendering-policy choice among the traced owners.
